keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no shape for 1940-1943 (its Republic of Iceland row starts in 1946). The island stays the kingdom's: Britain 'invaded on the morning of 10 May' 1940 (Operation Fork) and 'the defence of Iceland was transferred from Britain' to the United States from 7 July 1941, while Iceland 'remained officially neutral'. Drawn whole and hatched as occupied (ledger).

ledger.note: 1918, 1 December: Iceland becomes a sovereign kingdom. 'On 1 December 1918, the Act of Union, an agreement with Denmark, recognized Iceland as a fully sovereign state'; the Act would be reviewed in 1940 and could be revoked three years later. The Danish king remained king of Iceland.

1940, 10 May: Britain occupies Iceland. 'Operation Fork was launched by the United Kingdom when military forces sailed into Reykjavik Harbour' (Kingdom page); on the evening of 10 May the government protested that its neutrality had been 'flagrantly violated'. The Danish link had been cut by the German invasion of Denmark on 9 April 1940; the Althing took over foreign policy on 10 April.

1941, 7 July: the United States takes over Iceland's defence from Britain: the defence was 'transferred from Britain' on 7 July 1941 after the US agreement of 16 June. British troops numbered over 25,000 in July 1941 and the RAF stayed to the war's end.

1941, 7-8 July: American forces replace the British. 'The United States Marine Corps commenced landing on 8 July, and disembarkation was completed on 12 July'; the Althing adopted the American-Icelandic defence agreement in July 1941 (Kingdom page).

1944, 17 June: bookkeeping end of this dossier's occupation pair. The foreign forces stayed after the republic ('During the occupation, on 17 June 1944, Iceland declared itself a republic'; about 15,000 foreign troops in 1944; the Keflavik Agreement of 1946 provided for the American army to leave within six months). republic-of-iceland should carry the end of the American presence.
1944, 17 June: Iceland becomes a republic. 'Following a constitutional referendum in May 1944 (20 May), Iceland formally became a republic on 17 June 1944.'

wars.name: Operation Fork (British occupation of Iceland)
wars.outcome: The Royal Navy and Royal Marines landed at Reykjavik on 10 May 1940 without a fight beyond a protest; commonwealth forces 'eventually totalled 25,000'; the United States took over the defence on 7 July 1941.
wars.note: Iceland stayed neutral; the occupation moved no border.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border; Cliopatria draws the same 458 cells throughout.
